incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: AionUi opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart AionUi.

incompleteInstallation.title: AionUi installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest AionUi. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionCore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest AionUi package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionUi components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: AionUi package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This AionUi package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling AionUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of AionUi is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of AionUi, and this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of AionUi newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling AionUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart AionUi.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: AionUi detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, AionUi will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: AionUi is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another AionUi startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart AionUi.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: AionCore is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: AionCore couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: AionCore didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: AionCore failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

mcp.title: Conectar aplicativos
mcp.intro: Conecte os aplicativos que você usa no trabalho aos seus bots.
mcp.chromeDescription: Abre um Chrome com perfil próprio quando o bot usa uma ferramenta. Requer Chrome, Node.js e npm neste computador.

mcp.gmailCompatibility: Esta versão ainda não cadastra o cliente OAuth exigido pelo Google. Salvar o endereço prepara a conexão; a autorização continua pendente.
mcp.name: Nome
mcp.argumentsHint: Informe cada argumento como um item da lista, por exemplo: ["-y", "pacote@1.0.0"].

mcp.testHint: O teste verifica a lista de ferramentas. No Chrome, abrir páginas é uma ação do bot.
